Your car does not allow warming the battery remotely: the feature stays off for it.

With a fast-charging stop in the route plan and less than %1$d °C outside, about %2$d min before arriving the app asks the car to warm the battery, so it charges fast from the first minute. It is announced on the car screen and by voice, with “Cancel”.
It needs the Leapmotor account and the car PIN saved in Car data.
Your car replied that it does not have this feature: it stays off for it.
